description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Struct, which extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Collection, representing an XML-RPC struct value with methods for XML generation and construction from an array.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Struct
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC struct value, capable of generating its XML representation from an array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the struct with a given array value, setting the type to XMLRPC_TYPE_STRUCT.

methods.name: _generateXML
methods.description: Generates the XML representation of the struct, iterating over its array value and creating XML elements for each member.
